title: AHoJ-AlphaFold: analysis code for 'A tale of two states: AlphaFold binding pockets on the apo–holo continuum'
description: Code behind the manuscript A tale of two states: AlphaFold binding pockets on the apo–holo continuum: the probabilistic apo/holo classification of AlphaFold-DB binding pockets against AHoJ-DB reference structures, the binding-site unification, the downstream analyses (prevalence, AlphaFill, binding-site detection with P2Rank, fpocket and IF-SitePred, docking) and the generators of every figure. The data are deposited separately (10.5281/zenodo.23243349).
